name: Chicken Enchiladas
desc: Corn tortillas dipped in green chile sauce, rolled around chicken, green chiles and sour cream, and baked under Colby Jack.

source.title: Green Chili Chicken Enchiladas
source.evidence: Same recipe shape and amounts: 2 cups chicken, 2 cups Colby Jack divided, a 4 oz can green chiles, 8 corn tortillas dipped in hot green enchilada sauce, 1/3 cup filling plus 2 tbsp sour cream each, 350°F bake; Lil' Luna uses a 28 oz can of sauce.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese, divided
1 (19 oz) can green chile enchilada sauce
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: In a bowl, combine the chicken, 1 cup of the cheese, the green chiles, and salt and pepper.
In a small skillet, bring the enchilada sauce to a boil, then take it off the heat.
Dip each tortilla in the hot sauce for a few seconds to soften so it rolls without cracking.
Spoon 1/3 cup of the chicken mixture and 2 tbsp sour cream down the center of each tortilla. A sandwich bag with the corner cut off works well for piping the sour cream.
Roll each tortilla and place seam side down in an 8x8 in or 9x9 in baking dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and scatter with the remaining 1 cup cheese.
Bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling and the cheese has melted.

references.title: Green Chili Chicken Enchiladas
